title: Data Stories
description: Small experiments that turn messy questions into clear, useful insights.
content: Data Stories is an exploratory research project focused on uncovering hidden patterns in public datasets. Through data cleaning, interactive visualization, and statistical modeling, community members build open-source web dashboards that communicate complex data trends clearly to non-technical audiences.

title: Cloud Playground
description: A shared space to learn how services connect, scale and support real projects.
content: Cloud Playground provides hands-on infrastructure experiments using containerization, microservices architecture, and cloud deployment pipelines. Members collaborate on building serverless backends, setting up CI/CD workflows, and testing cluster orchestration tools.

title: Community Builds
description: Student-led ideas shaped through collaboration, feedback and hands-on practice.
content: Community Builds empowers DSCC members to pitch, prototype, and ship real-world software applications together. From internal club tools to public student utilities, projects follow agile practices with regular code reviews, sprint planning, and mentorship.
